tool_selection.reasoning: For tabular data, SHAP provides reliable, game-theoretic feature importance based on marginal contribution. LIME offers local interpretability by approximating the model with a simpler model. Integrated Gradients provide gradient-based attribution from a baseline, useful for detecting subtle influences. Sensitivity analysis quantifies feature impact through perturbation, offering robustness checks. Together, they cover both statistical and causal perspectives on feature responsibility.
